data.text: Section cost, measured on the prompt hook's real output for the 25 golden questions (KAD-53's raw outputs are not kept anywhere, so they were regenerated): 42 distinct DOC-N:a-b references, whole doc show --json median 9,184 B (~2,300 tok), section 1,346 B (~340 tok), median ratio 0.17, sum 517 KB vs 64 KB. doc show with a range: 113 ms median, 176 ms max. Core untouched. Also: npm test run from a shell with KADENCE_SOURCE=agent exported failed json-contract 'counts as human' — the test inherited the variable it tests; it now strips it.
